reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on their #central-random message. The reply confirms that the deadline for the signed Tansley Parcel order form is 3 April.

As they asked, I took no other action and left their #central-team post as it was. A deadline date is an account detail, not a money term, so it was fine to repeat in the channel. The workspace saves channel messages to the knowledge brain automatically, so their correction is on record there without me adding anything.
